description: Read the status of a trusted-device approval session: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED or EXPIRED. For a transfer, call this with the approval_session_id from request_transfer_approval once the user says they have answered on their phone, and call commit_transfer only when it returns APPROVED. Poll once per user prompt, not in a loop; a session expires about 5 minutes after it was opened.
name: approval_session_get_approval_session_status
title: Get Approval Session Status
